constants.name: Speed of Light in Vacuum
constants.description: Exact speed of all electromagnetic waves propagating through a vacuum.

constants.name: Vacuum Permittivity
constants.description: Electric constant describing the capability of a vacuum to permit electric field lines.

constants.name: Vacuum Permeability
constants.description: Magnetic constant (4π × 10⁻⁷ H/m) relating magnetic flux density to electric current; c² = 1 / (ε₀μ₀).

constants.name: Planck Constant
constants.description: Fundamental quantum constant relating photon energy to wave frequency: E = hf.

constants.name: Reduced Planck Constant
constants.description: Dirac constant equal to h / (2π), used in angular frequency and phase calculations.

constants.name: Elementary Charge
constants.description: Fundamental magnitude of electric charge carried by a single proton or electron.

constants.name: Pi
constants.description: Ratio of a circle's circumference to its diameter; represents a 180° angular phase shift.

constants.name: Refractive Index of Air
constants.description: Standard refractive index of air at STP (approximated as 1.00 in general optics calculations).

constants.name: Refractive Index of Water
constants.description: Standard optical refractive index of pure liquid water at 20°C.

constants.name: Minimum Visible Wavelength (Violet)
constants.description: Lower wavelength limit of the human visible optical spectrum (400 nm).

constants.name: Maximum Visible Wavelength (Red)
constants.description: Upper wavelength limit of the human visible optical spectrum (700 nm).
